confidence_notes: Current Zanzibar price-index data supports inexpensive meals, mid-range meals, cappuccino, and domestic draft beer. Cocktail pricing is based on current local bar ranges; wine is estimated at about three times a draft beer because a reliable aggregated local wine price was not found. Accommodation estimates are holistic and especially uncertain because prices vary sharply by season and between Stone Town and beach areas.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food anchors use Zanzibar-specific cost-of-living prices; lodging estimates reflect general knowledge of budget guesthouses and modest tourist hotels in Zanzibar and comparable East African island destinations.
